channel.title: AGSIST Daily
channel.description: Free morning market briefing for grain and livestock farmers: overnight futures, USDA reports and the news behind the moves. Posted most days between 5:45 and 6:30 a.m. Central.

item.title: Corn sits at $4.36½ after Wednesday's 2.5% drop; export sales due
item.dc:creator: AGSIST
item.description: Corn gave back 11¼ cents Wednesday and wheat gave back 25¼, the worst day for both in weeks. • Grains edge up after drop • Hogs lag, cattle firm Read more: https://agsist.com/daily/2026-11-19

item.title: December lean hogs fell $2.25 Tuesday to $53.10
item.dc:creator: AGSIST

item.title: Corn harvest reaches 88%; the five-year average is 92%
item.dc:creator: AGSIST
item.description: Corn harvest is 88% done, four points behind the usual 92% for mid-November. That puts roughly one acre in eight still standing, and a late finish means more days of machine and fuel cost on the last fields. • Grains slow harvest, firm corn • Cattle and hogs ease Monday Read more: https://agsist.com/daily/2026-11-17

item.title: Crude slips on supply glut fears; corn flat at $4.46 overnight
item.dc:creator: AGSIST
item.description: WTI crude is at $88.23 overnight, down 0.4%, after Goldman Sachs said supply could outrun demand by 2 million barrels a day in 2027. item.title: USDA reports Monday and Thursday open a week of mild rain

item.title: Soybeans gain 3.2% on the week; cattle and hogs rise too

item.dc:creator: AGSIST
